classification: legacy Emerald PokéNav shared BG1 message-box surface layered above the already-live authentic HGSS PokéGear fixed shell

behavior: decompresses the Emerald message-box graphics into BG1
copies the Emerald message-box tilemap into the shared PokéGear launcher BG1 buffer
loads the Emerald message-box palette into BG palette bank 1
shows BG1 above the authentic HGSS fixed shell
legacy_surface.functional_dependency: BG1 is also used by functional text/windows, but the legacy message-box artwork itself is presentation-only

retail_audit.finding: Retail HGSS PokegearApp_LoadSkinGraphics supplies the common fixed screen shell on the core PokéGear background layer. The current port already makes its option-description window transparent specifically to expose that verified shell rather than fabricate extra HGSS-style panel art.
retail_audit.layering_finding: In the current GBA renderer the legacy message-box surface is on BG1 priority 1 while the authentic fixed shell is on BG2 priority 2, so legacy BG1 pixels can occlude the verified retail shell.
retail_audit.conclusion: The authentic target is to preserve BG1 for functional windows/text while removing the Emerald message-box pixels/tilemap/palette so the already-live retail HGSS shell remains visible. No invented replacement artwork is required.

next: After Phase-1 CI passes, suppress only the Emerald message-box graphics/tilemap/palette behind a one-cycle rollback path while retaining BG1 and its functional windows/text.
status: phase 1: legacy BG1 message-box surface audited; authentic HGSS fixed shell already live underneath; rendering unchanged; CI pending
